sky cinema premiere.title: Reminders of Him
sky cinema premiere.desc: Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.

sky cinema action.title: Olympus Has Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

sky cinema action.title: Aquaman
sky cinema action.desc: Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan to save the underwater city of Atlantis -- and the surface world -- from his power-hungry brother.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 7
sky cinema action.desc: After defeating international terrorist Owen Shaw, Dominic Toretto, Brian O'Conner and the rest of the crew have separated to return to more normal lives. However, Deckard Shaw, Owen's older brother, is thirsty for revenge. A slick government agent offers to help Dom and company take care of Shaw in exchange for their help in rescuing a kidnapped computer hacker who has developed a powerful surveillance program.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious 8
sky cinema action.desc: The globetrotting crew faces an unexpected challenge when a mysterious woman named Cipher forces Dom to betray them all. Now, they must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop her from unleashing chaos on a grand scale.

sky cinema action.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
sky cinema action.desc: Brixton Lorr is a cybernetically enhanced soldier who possesses superhuman strength, a brilliant mind and a lethal pathogen that could wipe out half of the world's population. It's now up to hulking lawman Luke Hobbs and lawless operative Deckard Shaw to put aside their past differences and work together to prevent the seemingly indestructible Lorr from destroying humanity.

sky cinema family.title: The Rugrats Movie
sky cinema family.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

sky cinema family.title: Rugrats Go Wild
sky cinema family.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

sky cinema family.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
sky cinema family.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

sky cinema comedy.title: Superbad
sky cinema comedy.desc: Two inseparable best friends navigate the last weeks of high school and are invited to a gigantic house party. Together with their nerdy friend, they spend a long day trying to score enough alcohol to supply the party and inebriate two girls in order to kick-start their sex lives before they go off to college. Their quest is complicated after one of them falls in with two inept cops who are determined to show him a good time.

sky cinema comedy.title: Hitch
sky cinema comedy.desc: Albert is neither the most attractive nor the most confident man in the world, so when he falls in love with one of his firm's clients, Allegra Cole, he calls in an expert to help him win her over. Hitch is the business name of Alex Hitchins, and he earns his pay by teaching men how to woo the girl of their choice.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
sky cinema comedy.desc: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Naked Gun
sky cinema comedy.desc: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.

sky cinema comedy.title: Little Fockers
sky cinema comedy.desc: Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Ouija
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A séance scam leads to terror when an evil spirit possesses a widow's youngest daughter in 1967 Los Angeles.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Innerspace
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. Attempts by his colleagues to retrieve the little man - protected inside a tiny submersible - are hampered by the would-be thieves.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Assassin's Creed
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A descendant of the mysterious secret society known as the Assassins uses his newfound knowledge and physical skills to battle the power-hungry Templar Order.

sky cinema thriller.title: RocknRolla
sky cinema thriller.desc: Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.

sky cinema thriller.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema thriller.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema thriller.title: Red Dragon
sky cinema thriller.desc: Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis - the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.

sky cinema thriller.title: No Country for Old Men
sky cinema thriller.desc: A man stumbles on the aftermath of a drug deal and takes off with the loot, but the bad guys are in hot pursuit.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Identity
sky cinema thriller.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
sky cinema greats.desc: The crew of the Enterprise learns of a plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, and Capt Picard begins an open rebellion to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals the Federation was founded.

sky cinema greats.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
sky cinema greats.desc: Sequel unfolding a life-and-death battle to avert a nuclear holocaust. A supercomputer that sought to destroy humankind sends a virtually indestructible, shape-shifting cyborg back to our time to kill its enemy - the human resistance leader - in his youth. Aided by another cyborg, the boy and his mother try to alter the events that led to the computer's creation and the nuclear war which it triggered.

sky cinema greats.title: Deep Impact
sky cinema greats.desc: Apocalyptic thriller in which life on Earth is threatened by a rogue comet. When a reporter in pursuit of a Washington sex scandal is arrested by the FBI, she discovers that the story is an inconsequential part of a huge cover-up. She soon finds herself in possession of the biggest story in the history of humankind - the planet will be destroyed in one year, unless a risky outer-space mission can deflect the comet.

sky cinema greats.title: Lake Placid
sky cinema greats.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

sky cinema drama.title: Air
sky cinema drama.desc: Sonny Vaccaro and Nike pursue basketball rookie Michael Jordan, creating a partnership that revolutionizes the world of sports and contemporary culture.

sky cinema drama.title: Coach Carter
sky cinema drama.desc: Based on the true story of Coach Ken Carter, a controversial high school basketball coach who received national attention when he benched his undefeated team due to their collective poor academic record in 1999. In the face of much criticism, Carter fought to keep his methods, determined to show the boys that they need to rely on more than sports for their futures.

sky cinema drama.title: My Girl
sky cinema drama.desc: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.

sky cinema drama.title: Chicago
sky cinema drama.desc: Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.
